findings.description: Corrigendum No. SW/2026/SCH/118-A dated 2 September 2026 raises the annual family income limit in GO para 3.2 from Rs. 2,50,000 to Rs. 3,00,000 per annum. COR1-1 is the effective clause for eligibility.

The GO requires the institution nodal officer to verify the application within 15 days of submission (GO-5.1), but the kick-off meeting minutes record that institution verification shall be completed within 10 days (MIN-4).

GO-4.3 requires certificates not available in DigiLocker to be uploaded "in the prescribed format in Annexure A", but Annexure A has not been provided with the sources, so the upload format cannot be specified.
